project.name: Pixvideo
project.description: AI-powered video creation platform - Part of Pixelle ecosystem. 输入主题/脚本后串联文案生成、TTS配音、图像/视频生成、模板渲染和FFmpeg合成，快速制作短视频。

nodes.name: .dockerignore
nodes.summary: Docker build-context ignore rules for the Pixelle-Video image. Excludes Python build artifacts (__pycache__, *.pyc, dist/, egg-info), virtualenvs (.venv, venv), IDE files (.vscode, .idea), git metadata (.git), most docs (*.md except README.md), plans/repositories/examples dirs, tests, logs, output/* and temp files, user data (data/users/*), local config.yaml files, and macOS junk (.DS_Store). Explicitly keeps docs/images, docs/FAQ*.md, README.md, output/.gitkeep, data/.gitkeep, and config.example.yaml so only source needed for the image build enters the build context.

nodes.name: Dockerfile
nodes.summary: Multi-stage Docker build for Pixelle-Video. Stage 1 (node:22-alpine, 'frontend-builder') runs npm ci and npm run build to produce the React frontend bundle. Stage 2 (python:3.11-slim) installs system deps (curl, ffmpeg, fonts-noto-cjk for CJK rendering), installs the uv package manager, creates a venv, pip-installs the Python package in editable mode (copying pyproject.toml, uv.lock, README.md and the pixelle_video package first so hatchling can build), installs Playwright Chromium, copies api/, bgm/, templates/, workflows/, resources/, docs/ and the frontend dist output, creates /app/output, /app/data, /app/temp, EXPOSEs port 8000, and defaults to CMD ['uv', 'run', 'python', 'api/app.py']. Supports ARG USE_CN_MIRROR=true to swap apt sources to Aliyun and pip to the Tsinghua mirror for China deployments.

nodes.name: frontend-builder (build stage)
nodes.summary: Build stage of the Dockerfile based on node:22-alpine: copies frontend/package.json and package-lock.json, installs exact dependencies with npm ci, copies the frontend source, and runs npm run build. Its dist output is later copied into the final Python image via COPY --from=frontend-builder.

nodes.name: docker-compose.yml
nodes.summary: Docker Compose orchestration for Pixelle-Video defining the bridge network 'pixelle-network' and two services: 'init' (one-shot alpine container that fixes a mis-mounted config.yaml directory and creates config.yaml from config.example.yaml if missing) and 'api' (pixelle-video-api, built from ./Dockerfile with USE_CN_MIRROR passthrough, published on 127.0.0.1:8000, mounting ./config.yaml, ./data and ./output for persistence, curl healthcheck on /health, TZ=Asia/Shanghai, restart unless-stopped, 10MB/3-file json-file log rotation). The api service only starts after init completes successfully.

nodes.name: init
nodes.summary: One-shot bootstrap service (image alpine:latest, restart: no) that mounts the project directory at /workspace and, via a shell command: removes config.yaml if Docker mounted it as a directory (fixes the 'mounting a non-existent file creates a directory' issue), then copies config.example.yaml to config.yaml when the file is absent. The api service declares depends_on with condition service_completed_successfully, so config.yaml is guaranteed to exist before the API starts.

nodes.name: api
nodes.summary: Main backend service (container_name pixelle-video-api) built from the repo's Dockerfile with USE_CN_MIRROR=${USE_CN_MIRROR:-false}. Runs '.venv/bin/python api/app.py --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000', publishes 127.0.0.1:8000:8000 (localhost-only), mounts ./config.yaml (read-write so the Web UI can save settings), ./data and ./output for persistence, sets TZ=Asia/Shanghai, healthchecks http://localhost:8000/health with curl every 30s (10s timeout, 3 retries, 10s start period), restarts unless-stopped with rotated json-file logs, and joins the pixelle-network bridge.

nodes.name: config.example.yaml
nodes.summary: Master configuration template for Pixelle-Video. Copy to config.yaml before use (never commit config.yaml). Defines sections: project_name, workbench (scene_concurrency), llm (OpenAI-compatible), image_generation (OpenAI Images-compatible API, defaults to 65535.space/gpt-image-2), comfyui (server URL, RunningHub/BizyAir API keys, tts/image/video workflow defaults incl. edge-tts, minimax, mimo, qwen_audio inference modes), template (default frame template 1080x1920/image_default.html, composition modes, motion/subtitle toggles), quick_create (BGM defaults), and subtitle (custom font folder, default style).

nodes.name: docker-start.sh
nodes.summary: Docker quick-start launcher. Cleans up a config.yaml that was mounted as a directory (Docker mount pitfall), creates config.yaml from config.example.yaml when missing, detects docker-compose vs docker compose, then builds images and starts services (docker compose build && up -d). Prints service URLs (Web UI & API on :8000, /docs) and custom resource folders (data/bgm, data/templates, data/workflows).

nodes.name: pyproject.toml
nodes.summary: Core Python package manifest for pixelle-video v0.1.15 (Apache-2.0, Python >=3.11, hatchling build). Runtime dependencies: fastmcp, pydantic, loguru, pyyaml, edge-tts, certifi, ffmpeg-python, httpx, pillow, openai, fastapi, uvicorn[standard], python-multipart, comfykit, beautifulsoup4, moviepy, playwright. Optional dev deps: pytest, pytest-asyncio, ruff. Also configures ruff (line-length 100, py311, E/F/I rules, per-file E402 ignores for api/app.py and generate_video.py) and pytest (asyncio_mode=auto, testpaths=tests).

nodes.name: requirements-docs.txt
nodes.summary: Pip requirements for building the project documentation: mkdocs-material>=9.6.0, mkdocs-git-revision-date-localized-plugin>=1.5.0, mkdocs-static-i18n>=1.2.0. Installed via 'pip install -r requirements-docs.txt'.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package initializer for the Pixelle-Video API layer. Contains only the Apache-2.0 copyright header and a module docstring describing the layer as a FastAPI-based REST API for video generation services.

nodes.name: app.py
nodes.summary: FastAPI application entry point. Creates the 'Pixelle-Video API' app with an asynccontextmanager lifespan that starts the task manager, cleans ffmpeg scratch files, initializes PixelleVideoCore, resumes active project-generation runs and workbench exports (abandoning orphan scene jobs) on startup, and tears everything down on shutdown. Adds CORS middleware from api_config, includes 17 routers under /api (health without prefix), mounts frontend/dist as static files when built (else a dev fallback root route), and provides a uvicorn CLI runner (--host/--port/--reload).

nodes.name: config.py
nodes.summary: API configuration module. Defines the APIConfig pydantic BaseModel (host 127.0.0.1, port 8000, CORS origins for 4173/5173 dev servers, max_concurrent_tasks 5, task cleanup/retention intervals, 100MB upload cap, /api prefix, docs/redoc/openapi URLs) and instantiates the global api_config singleton consumed by app.py.

nodes.name: dependencies.py
nodes.summary: FastAPI dependency-injection helpers. Provides get_pixelle_video() which lazily creates and initializes a global PixelleVideoCore instance, shutdown_pixelle_video() which cleans up the core and closes the HTMLFrameGenerator browser, and the PixelleVideoDep Annotated type alias used by router endpoints to receive the core instance.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Router barrel module. Re-exports 17 APIRouter instances from the router submodules (configuration, content, files, frame, health, history, image, llm, projects, resources, specialist, style_slots, tasks, tts, uploads, video, workbench) and declares them in __all__, giving app.py a single import surface.

nodes.name: configuration.py
nodes.summary: Configuration endpoints (/config) for the React workbench. GET returns a sanitized view of the backend config (LLM, image generation, vision understanding, ComfyUI/RunningHub/BizyAir/MiniMax/Mimo/Qwen-audio API keys masked, service_status flags, quick_create/template presets); PUT persists config updates via config_manager; POST /test probes individual services (LLM connection, ComfyUI system_stats, image/vision completeness, API-key checks); GET/POST /presets load and save quick-create production defaults.

nodes.name: content.py
nodes.summary: Content generation endpoints (/content). POST /narration splits source text into narration segments, /keywords extracts highlight keywords with suggested colors, /image-prompt derives detailed image prompts from narrations, and /title generates a video title — all delegating to pixelle_video.utils.content_generators with the core LLM service.

nodes.name: files.py
nodes.summary: File serving endpoint (/files/{path}). Serves generated files (output/), workflows/, templates/, bgm/, data/bgm, data/templates, data/uploads (blocking manifest.json), custom-bgm/ (resolved from the configured custom BGM folder), and resources/ — enforcing path-traversal protection, mapping extensions to media types, and returning inline FileResponses for browser preview.

nodes.name: frame.py
nodes.summary: Frame/template rendering endpoints (/frame). POST /render renders a single frame image from an HTML template plus title/text/image via HTMLFrameGenerator, resolving template paths and parsing template size; GET /template/params returns custom template parameters ({{param:type=default}} syntax, types text/number/color/bool) and media dimensions for the workbench UI.

nodes.name: health.py
nodes.summary: Health endpoints (no prefix). GET /health and GET /version return a HealthResponse (status 'healthy', version 0.1.0, service 'Pixelle-Video API'); defines HealthResponse and CapabilitiesResponse pydantic models.

nodes.name: history.py
nodes.summary: Persisted generation history endpoints (/history). GET lists tasks with pagination/status/sort filters, enriching each with stored request params and video URLs; GET /{task_id} returns metadata, result, and storyboard (converted via persistence); DELETE removes a task and its files; POST /{task_id}/resume resumes a failed/interrupted generation synchronously with a progress callback.

nodes.name: image.py
nodes.summary: Image generation endpoint (/image/generate). Accepts prompt/width/height/workflow and delegates to the core media service via PixelleVideoDep, rejecting video workflows with a 400 and returning the generated image path for backward compatibility with the legacy image API.

nodes.name: llm.py
nodes.summary: LLM chat endpoint (/llm/chat). Passes prompt/temperature/max_tokens to the core llm service and returns the generated text plus token usage; wraps failures in HTTP 500.

nodes.name: projects.py
nodes.summary: Workbench project endpoints (/projects) — the largest router. Covers project CRUD (create with BGM validation, config-key allowlist, auto visual-prompt autofill and semantic scene segmentation; get/patch with optimistic concurrency), generation runs (start/pause/resume/cancel/retry-failed with status and allowed-actions), scene-level image/TTS/batch image generation jobs, asset version selection, scene reorder/timeline updates, uploads of scene images, from-history project creation with asset reuse, exports (create/cancel/retry with scene snapshots and ffmpeg process tracking), project media serving with Range support, and pipeline-progress observatory payloads (Chinese status summaries for the UI).

nodes.name: resources.py
nodes.summary: Resource discovery endpoints (/resources). Lists TTS/media/image ComfyUI workflows (RunningHub + self-hosted), HTML templates grouped by size/orientation, BGM files merged from default/custom/custom-folder sources, and subtitle fonts discovered from project/data/system/user/custom folders (with Chinese-font prioritization and family collapsing); serves approved font files, persists custom font/BGM folder selection via macOS osascript dialogs, and opens the BGM folder.

nodes.name: specialist.py
nodes.summary: Async specialist generation endpoints (/specialist). POST /custom-media/generate/async runs the AssetBasedPipeline over uploaded assets, /image-to-video/generate/async and /action-transfer/generate/async execute I2V/workflow jobs, and /digital-human/generate/async runs digital-human videos — all enqueueing tasks on task_manager, streaming progress events, persisting results via persist_specialist_video, and returning VideoGenerateAsyncResponse task IDs.

nodes.name: style_slots.py
nodes.summary: Reference-image style analysis and reusable style-slot endpoints (/style-slots). POST /analyze extracts style (prefix/tags/visual features/negative constraints/confidence) from an uploaded JPG/PNG/WebP via vision understanding; CRUD endpoints persist slots with their reference image through StyleSlotRepository, and GET /{slot_id}/image serves the stored reference JPEG.

nodes.name: tasks.py
nodes.summary: Task management endpoints (/tasks). GET lists tasks with optional status filter and limit, GET /{task_id} returns task details (status, progress, result), DELETE /{task_id} cancels a running/pending task via task_manager.

nodes.name: tts.py
nodes.summary: Text-to-speech endpoints (/tts). GET /qwen/capabilities lists Qwen TTS model modes (preset/instruct/design/clone, workspace-required models); POST /qwen/voice-design creates a reusable voice from a text description via the DashScope customization API and saves a preview wav; POST /qwen/voice-clone enrolls a cloned voice from an authorized 10-20s MP3/WAV/M4A sample; POST /synthesize renders speech through the core TTS service (workflow, ref_audio, legacy voice_id, speed, MiniMax/Mimo/Qwen-audio params) and returns the audio path plus duration.

nodes.name: api/routers/uploads.py
nodes.summary: FastAPI router for safe, server-owned uploads used by specialist video workflows (custom media, image-to-video, action transfer, digital human). Validates batch size (max 20 files) and per-UploadPurpose extension allowlists, streams chunks with 512MB/file and 1GB/batch caps, writes atomic batches to data/uploads/<upload_id>/ with manifest.json, and provides resolve_uploaded_file_keys() so other routers can resolve server-issued keys safely (path-traversal guarded).

nodes.name: api/routers/video.py
nodes.summary: FastAPI router for video generation. POST /video/generate/sync blocks until completion; POST /video/generate/async submits a background TaskManager task and returns a task_id for polling. Builds PixelleVideoCore.generate_video kwargs from VideoGenerateRequest via _build_video_params, auto-resolves media size from the frame template (HTMLFrameGenerator), and converts output paths to /api/files/ URLs via path_to_url.

nodes.name: api/routers/workbench.py
nodes.summary: FastAPI 'React Workbench' compatibility router keeping the new UI thin while delegating to PixelleVideo services. Quick-create presets CRUD (data/quick_create_presets.json) persisted through config_manager, prompt-prefix save, service test-connection (delegates to api.routers.configuration.test_service), copy-draft generation (LLM full draft or segmented per-scene narrations), storyboard analysis (deterministic split + optional LLM semantic segmentation with duration/boundary metadata), and script generation (narrations + visual prompts). 45 helpers normalize TTS modes, storyboard density, char-count modes, subtitle styles, and preset fields.

nodes.name: api/schemas/__init__.py
nodes.summary: Barrel module re-exporting the public API schema surface: base responses, LLM/TTS/image/content/video/uploads/specialist request-response models. Consumers import from api.schemas instead of reaching into individual modules.

nodes.name: api/schemas/base.py
nodes.summary: Base Pydantic response models: BaseResponse (success/message/data) and ErrorResponse (success/message/error).

nodes.name: api/schemas/configuration.py
nodes.summary: Pydantic payloads for the configuration API: LLM/ImageGeneration/VisionUnderstanding/ComfyUI config payloads, ConfigUpdateRequest, ServiceTestRequest (service enum: llm, image_generation, vision_understanding, comfyui, runninghub, bizyair, minimax, mimo, qwen_audio), QuickCreatePresetRequest, and generic APIResponse.

nodes.name: api/schemas/content.py
nodes.summary: Pydantic schemas for content generation endpoints: narration generation, image-prompt generation, title generation, and highlight keyword extraction (KeywordItem with word/color).

nodes.name: api/schemas/frame.py
nodes.summary: Pydantic schemas for frame/template rendering: FrameRenderRequest/Response, TemplateParamConfig, and TemplateParamsResponse (template params plus media size from template meta tags).

nodes.name: api/schemas/image.py
nodes.summary: Pydantic schemas for image generation: ImageGenerateRequest (prompt/size/workflow/use_api_image) and ImageGenerateResponse.

nodes.name: api/schemas/llm.py
nodes.summary: Pydantic schemas for LLM chat: LLMChatRequest (prompt/temperature/max_tokens) and LLMChatResponse (content/tokens_used).

nodes.name: api/schemas/resources.py
nodes.summary: Pydantic schemas for resource discovery: workflow/template/BGM/font info models and their list responses.

nodes.name: api/schemas/specialist.py
nodes.summary: Pydantic request schemas for specialist generation workflows built on uploaded assets: CustomMediaGenerateRequest, ImageToVideoGenerateRequest, ActionTransferGenerateRequest, and DigitalHumanGenerateRequest (with mode-aware cross-field validation).

nodes.name: api/schemas/tts.py
nodes.summary: Pydantic schemas for TTS synthesis: TTSSynthesizeRequest (inference_mode local/comfyui/minimax/mimo/qwen_audio, workflow, voice, ref_audio), TTSSynthesizeResponse, and Qwen voice-design request/response.

nodes.name: api/schemas/uploads.py
nodes.summary: Pydantic schemas for specialist uploads: UploadPurpose enum (6 specialist workflows), UploadedFile (server-owned file key/url), UploadResponse.

nodes.name: api/schemas/video.py
nodes.summary: Pydantic schemas for video generation: SubtitleStyle (drawtext/ass/hyperframes styling), VideoSceneInput, VideoGenerateRequest (pipeline, TTS, media, composition, BGM parameters), VideoGenerateResponse (sync) and VideoGenerateAsyncResponse (task_id).

nodes.name: api/schemas/workbench.py
nodes.summary: Pydantic schemas for the workbench project/generation APIs: project create/update, scene mutations, timeline holds, batch image regen, export, generation run/job responses, asset versioning, and pipeline progress observatory.

nodes.name: api/tasks/__init__.py
nodes.summary: Barrel module exposing async task primitives: Task, TaskStatus, TaskType, and the global task_manager singleton.

nodes.name: api/tasks/manager.py
nodes.summary: In-memory TaskManager singleton for async jobs: create_task with client_request_key idempotency, restore_task for persisted tasks, execute_task (asyncio background coroutine), progress tracking with frame-level events, cancel/list/get, and a periodic cleanup loop honoring api_config retention settings.

nodes.name: api/tasks/models.py
nodes.summary: Pydantic task data models: TaskStatus and TaskType enums (video_generation plus workbench scene/image/tts/export/project_run), TaskProgress with frame-level event fields, and Task with lifecycle timestamps.

nodes.name: generate_video.py
nodes.summary: Standalone demo/utility script: initializes PixelleVideoCore, generates a fixed-script Chinese video (好设计 vs 坏设计) with local Edge-TTS, image_default.html template, bizyair image workflow and BGM, writing to ~/Desktop/视频/pixelle_video_output.mp4.

nodes.name: pixelle_video/__init__.py
nodes.summary: Package entry point re-exporting PixelleVideoCore, the global pixelle_video instance, and config_manager; documents the async usage contract (initialize -> llm/tts/generate_video -> cleanup).

nodes.name: pixelle_video/config/__init__.py
nodes.summary: Configuration package barrel: re-exports loader functions, ConfigManager class, and config schema models; instantiates the global config_manager singleton.

nodes.name: pixelle_video/config/loader.py
nodes.summary: Pure-YAML config persistence: load_config_dict reads config.yaml (missing/corrupt -> default {}), save_config_dict writes with allow_unicode.

nodes.name: pixelle_video/config/manager.py
nodes.summary: ConfigManager singleton wrapping PixelleVideoConfig: deep-merge updates, typed getters (get_llm_config, get_comfyui_config with nested tts/image/video sections, image_generation, vision_understanding), setters for LLM/ComfyUI/prompt-prefix, save_quick_create_config persisting workbench Quick Create state (tts mode local/comfyui/minimax/mimo/qwen_audio, media workflow, subtitle style, template toggles), and template path validation.

nodes.name: pixelle_video/config/schema.py
nodes.summary: Single source of truth for configuration: 17 Pydantic models — LLMConfig, ImageGenerationConfig, VisionUnderstandingConfig, TTS sub-configs (Local/ComfyUI/MiniMax/MiMo/QwenAudio), TTSSubConfig, Image/VideoSubConfig, ComfyUIConfig, TemplateConfig, QuickCreateConfig, SubtitleConfig, WorkbenchConfig, and root PixelleVideoConfig with is_llm_configured/validate_required/to_dict.

nodes.name: _validate_uploads
nodes.summary: Validates upload batch: non-empty, max 20 files, and per-upload-purpose extension allowlist; raises HTTPException 413/415/422.

nodes.name: resolve_uploaded_file_keys
nodes.summary: Resolves server-issued file keys (data/uploads/<id>/<name>) to absolute paths, verifying path containment, manifest ownership, and purpose match; raises 422 on invalid keys.

nodes.name: upload_files
nodes.summary: POST /uploads handler: streams chunks with size caps, writes an atomic batch dir with manifest.json, and returns UploadResponse with safe file keys; cleans up batch dir on failure.

nodes.name: path_to_url
nodes.summary: Converts absolute/relative output paths to /api/files/ URLs using the request base_url, handling Windows and POSIX separators.

nodes.name: _resolve_media_size
nodes.summary: Determines media dimensions from the request body or from frame-template meta via HTMLFrameGenerator.

nodes.name: _build_video_params
nodes.summary: Maps VideoGenerateRequest into PixelleVideoCore.generate_video kwargs (pipeline, scenes, TTS incl. qwen/minimax/mimo, media, subtitle, motion, BGM); drops None values.

nodes.name: generate_video_sync
nodes.summary: POST /video/generate/sync handler: generates video synchronously via PixelleVideoDep and returns video_url/duration/file_size.

nodes.name: generate_video_async
nodes.summary: POST /video/generate/async handler: creates a TaskManager task, runs generation with a progress_callback in the background, and returns task_id immediately.

nodes.name: _ensure_llm_configured
nodes.summary: Raises 400 with a Chinese message if LLM api_key/base_url/model are not saved in config_manager.

nodes.name: _normalize_draft_mode
nodes.summary: Maps draft mode: 'segmented' -> 'segmented', anything else -> 'full'.

nodes.name: _normalize_split_type
nodes.summary: Validates split type in {auto, paragraph, line, sentence}; default 'auto'.

nodes.name: _normalize_segmentation_mode
nodes.summary: Validates segmentation mode in {auto, deterministic, llm}; default 'auto'.

nodes.name: _normalize_director_mode
nodes.summary: Maps 'custom' -> 'custom', anything else -> 'auto'.

nodes.name: _normalize_storyboard_density
nodes.summary: Validates density in {sparse, standard, dense}; default 'standard'.

nodes.name: _density_chars_per_scene
nodes.summary: Chars-per-scene rhythm target by density: sparse 60 / standard 40 / dense 28.

nodes.name: _should_soft_expand
nodes.summary: Decides soft comma-expansion: explicit request wins; disabled for sparse density or continuous tts_delivery.

nodes.name: _normalize_char_count_mode
nodes.summary: Maps char-count mode: 'within' -> 'within', anything else -> 'around'.

nodes.name: _char_count_phrase
nodes.summary: Builds Chinese char-count phrase, e.g. '175 字左右' or '175 字以内'.

nodes.name: _per_storyboard_word_range
nodes.summary: Per-scene narration word range derived from target char count, scene count, and mode.

nodes.name: _format_segmented_draft
nodes.summary: Joins cleaned narrations with blank lines to form a segmented draft.

nodes.name: _strip_segment_prefix
nodes.summary: Cleans a segment's text via clean_narration_text (removes prefixes).

nodes.name: _narrations_and_visual_focus_from_confirmed_copy
nodes.summary: Core builder: turns confirmed copy into narrations/visual focuses/text-anchor hints via deterministic semantic packing (split_draft_by_rule, optional soft_expand_by_pause, pack_semantic_units, rebalance_long_units), falls back to LLM topic narration when copy is empty, and optionally runs LLM semantic segmentation for overlong copy.

nodes.name: _narrations_from_confirmed_copy
nodes.summary: Narration-only wrapper around the focus-aware builder for callers that do not need focus hints.

nodes.name: _frontend_tts_mode
nodes.summary: Maps backend TTS mode to the frontend ttsMode value (minimax/mimo/comfyui/local).

nodes.name: _backend_tts_mode
nodes.summary: Maps TTS mode to the backend inference mode (minimax/mimo/comfyui/edge).

nodes.name: _storyboard_analysis_units
nodes.summary: Attaches chars/estimatedSeconds/boundaryReason/visualFocus/textAnchors metadata to narration units.

nodes.name: _extract_text_anchors
nodes.summary: Extracts short factual anchors (weekdays, dates, times, percentages) via regex; max 3.

nodes.name: _storyboard_analysis_warnings
nodes.summary: Warns when units exceed the safe char limit or estimated duration threshold.

nodes.name: _is_frontend_placeholder
nodes.summary: Detects frontend placeholder values (bgm-, tpl-, runninghub-, bizyair-, comfyui- prefixes).

nodes.name: _now_iso
nodes.summary: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp helper.

nodes.name: _coerce_int
nodes.summary: Coerces value to int with fallback default, clamped to [minimum, maximum].

nodes.name: _coerce_float
nodes.summary: Coerces value to float with fallback default, clamped to [minimum, maximum].

nodes.name: _normalize_subtitle_style
nodes.summary: Normalizes a raw subtitle style dict via SubtitleRenderer().normalize_style so box/stroke intent matches export.

nodes.name: _normalize_preset

nodes.name: bookend.py
nodes.summary: Project-level intro/outro bookend packaging defaults and normalization. Normalizes project/export config into a canonical bookend dict (enabled, intro_seconds, outro_seconds, fade seconds) accepting camelCase (frontend) and snake_case (backend) keys, clamping fades to pad durations. Product defaults: intro 1.2s / outro 2.0s.

nodes.name: content_generators.py
nodes.summary: Pure/stateless LLM content generation utilities reused across pipelines: title generation (auto/direct/llm strategies), narration generation from topic/content with batch + top-up strategy for 50-100 scene counts, narration script splitting, semantic segmentation, highlight keyword extraction (LLM with heuristic fallback + color palette), image prompt and video prompt generation with batching/retry, and robust LLM JSON parsing/recovery (truncated arrays, unescaped quotes, markdown fences, trailing commas).

nodes.name: ffmpeg_scratch.py
nodes.summary: Shared ffmpeg/TTS temp directory helpers and garbage collection. Provides a stable OS-temp scratch dir (pixelle_video_ffmpeg) and cleanup_ffmpeg_scratch which deletes stale files older than max_age_hours plus empty subdirs; called on API startup.

nodes.name: llm_util.py
nodes.summary: LLM utility functions for model discovery and connection testing against OpenAI-compatible /v1/models endpoints using httpx (trust_env=False to avoid dead local proxies). fetch_available_models lists model IDs; test_llm_connection returns (success, message, model_count) with detailed error mapping for 401/403/404/timeout.

nodes.name: os_util.py
nodes.summary: OS utilities for file and path management (inspired by Pixelle-MCP's os_util.py). Resolves the project root via PIXELLE_VIDEO_ROOT env var, provides temp/data/output path builders, byte-file saving, task ID generation and per-task output directory layout (output/{task_id}/frames/...), and resource management for bgm/templates/workflows with custom-override priority (data/<type> before <type>).

nodes.name: project_config.py
nodes.summary: Project config dual-key normalization between camelCase (editor/UI-owned, preferred when both present) and snake_case (pipeline) for ~26 key pairs (enableSubtitles, bgmVolume, mediaWidth, ttsMode, workflowId, bookendEnabled, directorMode, density, styleSlotId, etc.). pick_config returns first non-None key; normalize_project_config dual-writes both casings, preserves legacy sceneCount as a soft custom director target, and aliases workflow/media_workflow.

nodes.name: prompt_helper.py
nodes.summary: Prompt helper utilities for composing and validating visual prompts: whitespace normalization for comparing user-facing prompt fields, legacy fallback detection (visual_prompt copied from narration), and final image prompt assembly with an optional style prefix applied only at the provider boundary.

nodes.name: storyboard_split.py
nodes.summary: Semantic storyboard packing that mirrors frontend/src/lib/storyboardSplit.ts. Splits narration drafts into duration-aware units (auto/paragraph/line/sentence modes) without inventing mid-word/mid-phrase hard cuts: sentence-unit splitting, long-sentence splitting at pauses/semantic joins, bounded rhythm fallback for unpunctuated CJK text, soft-expand on pause punctuation, semantic packing to a target scene count, and healing of mid-cut segments.

nodes.name: template_util.py
nodes.summary: Template utility functions for size parsing and template management. Parses WIDTHxHEIGHT sizes from template paths, lists available sizes/templates merged from default and custom (data/) locations via os_util resource API, resolves template paths with backward-compatible default.html->image_default.html migration, detects template type (static_/image_/video_ naming), and builds TemplateInfo/TemplateDisplayInfo models grouped by size and type for the UI.

nodes.name: tts_audio_postprocess.py
nodes.summary: Lightweight per-scene TTS clip post-processing to reduce 'different speaker' artifacts: single-pass loudnorm (target I=-16 LUFS), short fade in/out via ffmpeg-python compiled command run with subprocess timeout (bounded 30-180s), writing to the shared ffmpeg scratch dir. Also provides with_speaker_lock which appends a Chinese speaker-identity constraint to multi-scene style prompts.

nodes.name: tts_util.py
nodes.summary: Edge TTS utility (original edge-tts implementation, temporarily unused — TTS service currently uses ComfyUI workflows). edge_tts() synthesizes speech with retry (exponential backoff + jitter), concurrency limiting via per-event-loop semaphore, request delay, word-boundary subtitle alignment saving, and optional output file. Also provides get_audio_duration (ffmpeg probe with size-based estimate fallback) and list_voices with locale filter.

nodes.name: video_canvas.py
nodes.summary: Video canvas (成片规格) vs image-generation size mapping. Defines 8 canvas presets (1080x1920 default @30fps, 720x1280 fast, 1440x2560 advanced, 16:9 and 1:1 variants), normalizes canvas config (width/height/fps with clamping, even dimensions for yuv420, tier detection), and maps any canvas to the nearest image-API whitelist size by orientation, aspect ratio, and pixel count.

nodes.summary: Parse (width, height) from a template path's size directory (WIDTHxHEIGHT), validating bounds and format; raises ValueError with guidance.

nodes.name: list_available_sizes
nodes.summary: List available template sizes merged from templates/ and data/templates/ via os_util, filtered to valid WIDTHxHEIGHT dir names, sorted.

nodes.name: list_templates_for_size
nodes.summary: List .html template filenames for a size, merged from default and custom locations.

nodes.name: get_template_full_path
nodes.summary: Resolve a template's full path (custom first), raising FileNotFoundError listing available templates on miss.

nodes.name: format_template_display_info
nodes.summary: Build TemplateDisplayInfo (name, size, orientation, is_standard for the 3 standard sizes) for the UI layer.

nodes.name: get_all_templates_with_info
nodes.summary: Collect TemplateInfo for every template across all sizes (path + display info).

nodes.name: get_templates_grouped_by_size
nodes.summary: Group all templates by size, ordered by orientation priority portrait > landscape > square.

nodes.name: resolve_template_path
nodes.summary: Resolve flexible template input (None default, bare name, size/name, legacy templates/ or data/templates/ paths) to a full path; migrates default.html -> image_default.html with fallback.

nodes.name: get_template_type
nodes.summary: Detect template type from filename convention static_*/image_*/video_*, defaulting to image with a warning.

nodes.name: filter_templates_by_type
nodes.summary: Filter TemplateInfo list by type (static/image/video).

nodes.name: get_templates_grouped_by_size_and_type
nodes.summary: Group templates by size with optional type filter, orientation-ordered.

nodes.name: TemplateDisplayInfo
nodes.summary: Pydantic model carrying template display info for the UI layer: name, size, width, height, orientation (portrait/landscape/square), is_standard.

nodes.name: TemplateInfo
nodes.summary: Pydantic model bundling a resolved template_path with its TemplateDisplayInfo.

nodes.name: _get_request_semaphore
nodes.summary: Get or create the per-event-loop asyncio semaphore limiting concurrent Edge TTS requests (max 3).

nodes.name: edge_tts
nodes.summary: Synthesize speech via Microsoft Edge TTS: semaphore-limited, rate-limited, retry with exponential backoff + jitter for 401/NoAudioReceived, collects word boundaries for subtitle alignment (edge_word_boundaries_to_cues + save_alignment), optionally saves audio to output_path, returns MP3 bytes.

nodes.name: get_audio_duration
nodes.summary: Get audio duration in seconds via ffmpeg probe, falling back to a file-size estimate (~2KB/s MP3) with a 1s floor.

nodes.name: list_voices
nodes.summary: List Edge TTS voice ShortNames, optionally locale-filtered, with the same semaphore + retry strategy.

edges.note: Parallel data-model layers: legacy generation models (storyboard) vs editable project models (workbench)
PixelleVideoCore exposes workbench services consuming workbench models
LinearVideoPipeline implements the BasePipeline contract via template method
Both configure LLM interactions (provider presets vs prompt builders)

layers.name: API Layer (FastAPI)
layers.description: HTTP 入口与请求处理：FastAPI 应用装配（app.py）、依赖注入（dependencies.py）、REST 路由（routers/，含 projects/workbench/video/tts 等 17 个路由模块）、Pydantic 请求/响应 schema（schemas/）以及内存异步任务管理（tasks/）。所有端点经依赖注入调用 pixelle_video 核心服务。

layers.name: Core Services
layers.description: 核心业务服务层：PixelleVideoCore 门面（service.py）统一编排 LLM/TTS/图像/视频能力，pixelle_video/services/ 下 28 个业务服务（LLM、TTS、视频、帧处理、字幕、工作台、持久化、历史等），包入口 __init__.py 与独立 CLI 演示入口 generate_video.py。

layers.name: Video Generation Pipelines
layers.description: 视频生成管线层：BasePipeline 抽象基类定义管线契约，StandardPipeline（默认）、LinearPipeline（线性分段）、CustomPipeline（自定义模板）与 AssetBasedPipeline（素材驱动）实现完整视频生成工作流，可访问全部核心服务并上报进度事件。

layers.name: Data Models
layers.description: 数据模型层：media（媒体）、progress（进度事件）、storyboard（分镜/生成结果）、workbench（工作台）数据类，是管线、服务与 API 之间传递数据的核心结构。

layers.name: LLM Prompt Templates
layers.description: LLM 提示词模板层：9 个提示词模块（标题/主题/内容解说、图片生成与风格转换、分镜切分、视频生成、素材脚本等），被 utils 与 services 消费，集中管理所有面向 LLM 的提示工程。

layers.name: Utilities
layers.description: 工具函数层：pixelle_video/utils/ 下 14 个共享工具模块（LLM 工具、TTS 工具、ffmpeg 暂存、模板渲染、视频画布、分镜切分、内容生成器等），被服务、管线与 API 层广泛复用。

layers.name: Configuration
layers.description: 配置层：ConfigManager 单例 + YAML 加载器 + 17 个 Pydantic 配置模型（schema.py 为配置单一事实来源）、LLM/TTS 预设数据（llm_presets.py、tts_voices.py）、示例配置 config.example.yaml 与项目清单 pyproject.toml。

layers.name: Infrastructure & Deployment
layers.description: 部署与启动层：Dockerfile（含 frontend-builder 构建阶段）、docker-compose.yml（init/api 服务）、.dockerignore、docker-start.sh、start_web.sh/bat、macOS 启动器、文档依赖清单 requirements-docs.txt 与项目声明 NOTICE。

layers.name: Analysis & Test Tooling
layers.description: 分析/测试工具产物：Understand-Anything 扫描配置与中间结果（.ua/）、Playwright UI 测试页面快照（.playwright-cli/），非运行时组成部分。

tour.title: 项目概览：Pixvideo 是什么
tour.description: 先建立全局认知：pyproject.toml 声明了包结构与依赖（FastAPI/OpenAI SDK/ComfyUI），pixelle_video/__init__.py 是核心包的入口，generate_video.py 是不经过 HTTP 的 CLI 演示入口，可以直接跑通一条最简单的生成链路。看完这三个文件你就能理解项目由「FastAPI 应用层 + pixelle_video 核心库」两部分组成。

tour.title: API 入口与依赖注入
tour.description: api/app.py 是 FastAPI 装配点：lifespan 启动任务管理器、清理 ffmpeg 临时文件、初始化 PixelleVideoCore 并恢复未完成的生成任务。api/dependencies.py 提供 get_pixelle_video() 依赖注入，让所有路由共享同一个核心单例。routers/__init__.py 汇总注册全部路由；tasks/manager.py 是内存异步任务管理。可顺带看 video.py 的 generate_video_async 端点理解 HTTP 如何触发一条视频生成。

tour.title: 核心门面：PixelleVideoCore
tour.description: service.py 是整个系统的组合根（composition root）：全局单例，懒加载 ComfyKit 客户端，持有所有服务实例（LLM/TTS/Media/Video 等）和管线注册表（standard/custom/asset_based），并提供 generate_video 包装器。initialize() 完成启动装配，_create_generate_video_wrapper() 展示了如何把管线挂到核心上。理解它你就掌握了整个依赖图的中心。

tour.title: 管线基类：BasePipeline
tour.description: pipelines/base.py 定义所有视频生成管线的契约：BasePipeline 持有 PixelleVideoCore 引用和 llm/tts/media/video/image 便捷别名，抽象 __call__ 返回 VideoGenerationResult，_report_progress 负责向 UI 上报进度。先看契约，再看四个实现——linear.py（线性分段）、custom.py（自定义模板）、asset_based.py（素材驱动营销视频）——理解不同管线如何复用同一套服务。

tour.title: 具体管线：StandardPipeline 全流程
tour.description: 默认且最完整的管线，按阶段跟踪它的生命周期：setup_environment（环境准备）→ generate_content（解说词生成）→ plan_visuals（画面规划）→ produce_assets（逐帧 TTS+媒体+合成）→ post_production（拼接+BGM）→ finalize（收尾持久化）。每个函数对应标准视频生成的一个阶段，是理解整个系统数据流的最佳路径。

tour.title: LLM 服务与提示词模板
tour.description: LLMService 封装 OpenAI SDK：配置热重载、结构化输出（_call_with_structured_output）和思考控制，是解说词、分镜、画面提示词的统一出口。同时看 prompts/ 下的提示词模板——storyboard_segmentation.py（分镜切分）、image_generation.py（图片提示词）、content_narration.py（解说词）——理解提示工程如何驱动内容生成。

tour.title: TTS 服务：多后端语音合成
tour.description: TTSService 是语音合成门面，支持本地 Edge TTS、ComfyUI workflow、MiniMax、MiMo、Qwen Audio 五种后端（__call__ 分发，各自 _call_* 实现）。continuous_tts/assemble.py 实现跨场景连续解说词拼接（决定用连续 TTS 还是逐场景 TTS），tts_audio_postprocess.py 负责静音裁剪等后处理。

tour.title: 媒体生成与视频合成服务
tour.description: 这组服务负责「素材生产」：MediaService 基于 ComfyUI workflow 生成图像/视频（ComfyBaseService 提供公共基类，含 OpenAI/BizyAir 兜底）；VideoService 是 ffmpeg 合成器（拼接、音视频合并、BGM、书挡包装）；FrameProcessor 把单个分镜帧走完「TTS→媒体→HTML 合成字幕→编码」全流程；SubtitleRenderer 规划并烧录 ASS 字幕。

tour.title: 数据模型：管线与 API 之间的数据契约
tour.description: models/ 定义贯穿全系统的数据结构：storyboard.py 是核心——StoryboardConfig（生成参数）、StoryboardFrame（单帧解说/音频/图像/视频状态）、Storyboard（分镜集合）、VideoGenerationResult（管线最终产物）；progress.py 的 ProgressEvent 是管线向 UI 汇报进度的结构化事件；media.py 的 MediaResult 描述 ComfyUI 产出的媒体文件；workbench.py 则是工作台项目的数据类（Project/Scene/GenerationRun 等）。

tour.title: 配置系统：单一事实来源
tour.description: config/schema.py 是配置的单一事实来源：17 个 Pydantic 模型（LLM、TTS 五种后端、ComfyUI、模板、字幕、工作台等），PixelleVideoConfig 是根配置。ConfigManager 是单例门面：深度合并更新、类型化 getter（get_llm_config 等）、setter 与持久化；loader.py 负责纯 YAML 读写。改配置行为先来这里。

tour.title: 工具函数与持久化
tour.description: utils/ 是被各层复用的共享工具：llm_util.py（模型发现与连接测试）、tts_util.py（Edge TTS 实现）、storyboard_split.py（语义化分镜打包，与前端 storyboardSplit.ts 对齐）、template_util.py（模板尺寸解析）、ffmpeg_scratch.py（ffmpeg 临时目录与 GC）。PersistenceService 用文件系统 JSON 持久化任务数据（断点恢复依赖它）。

tour.title: 工作台：可编辑项目的并发编排
tour.description: 工作台是面向可编辑本地视频项目的子系统：ProjectGenerationService 负责并发、可暂停/恢复/取消的生成编排（run() 是主循环，按场景波浪处理）；ProjectGenerationPlanner 用 sha256 指纹生成确定性参数快照做新鲜度检查；WorkbenchRepository 用 SQLite 持久化项目/场景/素材版本/生成任务；WorkbenchJobService 管理异步作业。看完这层就理解了新版可编辑工作流与旧版一次性生成的区别。
